quote: M-teams are management support groups made up of 3 to 6 managers who are in timezones that allow for sync meetings among members.
fact: M-teams are manager support groups of 3 to 6 managers in timezones that allow sync meetings.

quote: **Acting** means that someone is occupying this role temporarily and will move back to their original role after a set amount of time or other conditions, such as an external hire.
fact: An Acting title means the person holds the role temporarily and returns to their original role later, e.g. after an external hire.

quote: **Interim** means the individual is working on a promotion into the role.
fact: An Interim title means the person is working on a promotion into that role.

quote: For example, each Strategic Account Executive (SAE) works with one Sales Development Representative (SDR).
fact: Under the stable counterparts model, each Strategic Account Executive works with one Sales Development Representative.

quote:
1. Why is this important to the person/team I'm escalating to?
1. What are the relevant details of the challenge?
1. What have you tried?
1. What do you need?
fact: An explicit escalation should answer four questions: why it matters to the person escalated to, the relevant details, what was tried, and what is needed.

quote: in E-Group, members agree that they will not go to the CEO with an escalation without first notifying other relevant members that this is happening.
fact: E-Group members agree not to escalate to the CEO without first notifying other relevant members.

quote: **7 Stages to developing high performing teams:**
fact: GitLab's model for developing high performing teams has 7 stages.

quote: Books in this section [can be expensed](/handbook/finance/spending-company-money/).
fact: Books on the leadership reading list can be expensed.

quote: The CEO conducts quarterly skip-level meetings with all indirect reports.
fact: The CEO holds skip-level meetings with all indirect reports every quarter.

quote:
Skip level meetings can be conducted one-on-one or in groups of no more than
   10-15 (to encourage participation).
fact: Group skip-level meetings should have no more than 10-15 people.

quote: The skip level meeting is never recorded as it is a way to build trust with the team members.
fact: Skip-level meetings are never recorded, to build trust.

quote: "No matrix organization" means that everyone reports to exactly one person.
fact: In GitLab's no-matrix organization, everyone reports to exactly one person.

quote: Leaders should know the details of their organization three levels down for efficient and effective cross-functional decision-making.
fact: Leaders are expected to know the details of their organization three levels down.

quote: it is preferable for the manager and their direct report to have a minimum of two regularly scheduled synchronous 1-1s every month
fact: Managers and direct reports should have at least two scheduled synchronous 1-1s each month.

quote: If the manager puts more than half of the items on the agenda this is an indication that something is wrong.
fact: If the manager adds more than half of the 1-1 agenda items, something is wrong.

quote: The manager should strive to do 20% of the talking while the direct report does 80%.
fact: In a 1-1 the manager should talk about 20% of the time and the report 80%.

quote: **Cadence**: Schedule your Engagement Check-In at least every 6 months with each of you direct reports.
fact: Leadership Engagement Check-Ins (stay interviews) should happen at least every 6 months with each direct report.

quote: Group: Continue 1-1-1s for up to a month (if needed)
fact: When a team member changes manager, 1-1-1 transition meetings can continue for up to a month.

quote: The order going through the agenda is last-to-first, this way things that are still top of mind get handled first.
fact: In the suggested 1:1 agenda, items within a header are discussed last-to-first.

quote: `DOTO` - manager needs to do something
fact: The DOTO tag in a 1:1 agenda marks something the manager needs to do.

quote: It is best practice for the manager to meet with their team member at least once a week to monitor and discuss their performance.
fact: When coaching underperformance, the manager should meet the team member at least weekly.

quote: the team member may not be eligible for compensation increases from the [annual compensation review](/handbook/total-rewards/compensation/compensation-review-cycle/) or the [annual refresh grant program]
fact: Team members under active performance management may be ineligible for annual compensation review increases and refresh grants.

quote: When in the process of underperformance remediation team members are generally not eligible for transfer to other roles within GitLab.
fact: Team members in underperformance remediation are generally not eligible to transfer to other roles internally.

quote: typically organizations have ~25% of team members "exceeding", 60-65% "performing", and 10-15% "developing".
fact: Expected performance distribution is about 25% exceeding, 60-65% performing and 10-15% developing.

quote: Team members with less than 6 months tenure were not eligible for a refresh based on our eligibility cut off date.
fact: Team members with under 6 months tenure were not eligible for an equity refresh grant.

quote: Your salary will be increased to (insert $ amount in local currency) which is a (insert %) adjustment effective, February 1st.
fact: Annual compensation review increases take effect on February 1st.

quote: **IDEAL** - Six steps of delegations.
fact: GitLab's IDEAL delegation model has six steps.

quote: Professional coaching by external coaches is offered for managers and IC's Job Grade 8 and above using the [Growth and Development Fund]
fact: External professional coaching is offered to managers and ICs at Job Grade 8 and above through the Growth and Development Fund.

quote: This will be done by identifying 1-2 year initiatives as well as 3-5 year initiatives.
fact: Workforce planning action plans identify both 1-2 year and 3-5 year initiatives.
